structure.qualification: Import occurrences use physical non-test imports and committed plan ownership/order, including new files in cell roots. Unresolved loaders and unowned modules are reported, not proven absent. Lint cycles count physical package/app cycles; a flat source tree can have zero physical cycles while planned cuts remain.

events.population: native event records; receipt durations describe recorded runs, not fresh coverage

landings.deduplication: first item+commit globally in native event order

acceptToLand.scope: latest acceptance of latest submitted source head before landing; submit/reject/reopen/withdraw/patch/edit invalidate prior acceptance

landedCohortSubmits.scope: recorded timestamped submits through each item's latest landing in window

conflictReopens.scope: window reopen events with typed conflict cause/metadata only

proofReceipts.deduplication: native receipt id globally; conflicting ids excluded
proofReceipts.windowTimestamp: receipt.at only; absent/invalid timestamps excluded, never inferred from event recording time
proofReceipts.qualification: recorded receipt duration phase meaning is unknown; neither total-run nor frozen-check duration is inferred; recorded runtime is executor metadata, deeper runtimes unknown

unknown.scope: invalid history anchors/deduplication inputs across the full recorded event table

frozenCheck.population: unique submit receipt IDs in (from,to] that also bind a canonical v2 receipt, source head/tree, current retained frozen digest and exact frozen command SHA256
frozenCheck.qualification: Recorded frozen-command durationMs, not controller wall time or inherited timing receipt runMs. Historical criteria replaced by refreezes are unknown. Includes green and red attempts; canonical receipt files are required and no total/full-suite duration is inferred.

historicalSuiteLogs.population: one extracted TAP duration per unique coordinator-supplied historical full-suite-labelled log file
historicalSuiteLogs.qualification: Historical log observations, including failed or possibly incomplete collections; filenames and zero failures do not prove full coverage, source identity, or a current green suite. This separate population is not the board-event observation window.

qualification: Original committed 338-cut plan source measured with the current tool. Later regenerated 364-cut plan and current progress remain separate. Historical suite-labelled TAP log observations have their own 14–18 October population, not this board-event window.

capture.method: Current read-only event/lint generator against original committed plan checkout, with live board opened readOnly; temporary source worktree removed immediately. Metrics are immutable captured data, not a mutable lint allowance.
